properties.title: US-Israel Launch Operation Epic Fury Against Iran
properties.description: U.S. and Israeli forces kicked off an ongoing strike campaign against targets in Iran on Saturday, President Donald Trump announced in the early morning.

properties.title: Tehran Retaliates Across Region
properties.description: The U.S. Operation Epic Fury and Israeli Operation Raging Lion struck at Iranian leadership and military targets across the country, launching from both sea and land airbases, according to multiple reports.

properties.title: U.S. Army Attack Helicopters Hold Maritime Attack Drills in the Pacific
properties.description: Pacific-based U.S. Army Apache attack helicopters recently rehearsed maritime missions in preparation for regional deployments to upcoming exercises across the first island chain.

properties.title: Swedish Forces Jam Suspected Russian Drone Near French Carrier Charles De Gaulle
properties.description: Swedish forces intercepted and jammed a suspected Russian drone Wednesday in the Öresund Strait near the port city of Malmo where French aircraft carrier FS Charles De Gaulle (R91) is docked.

properties.title: US-Iran Conflict Raises Tensions in the Region
properties.description: The ongoing US-Israeli strike campaign against Iran has raised tensions in the region, with multiple countries involved in the conflict.

properties.title: Rare Earth Facility in Canada
properties.description: Saskatchewan Research Council (SRC), Canada's second-largest research organization, has built the world's first fully integrated rare earth facility.
